title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Preserve the supplied garment's visible shape, colour, print, labels and construction; add no unverified features.
STYLE: Realistic cinematic commercial, soft directional light, natural shadows and one smooth, purposeful camera move.
MODEL: No human or animal model; show the garment alone.
SCENE: a simple, tasteful fashion setting; keep the background simple and the garment clearly readable.
ACTION: 0–2s Begin with a clear full view of the garment; let the fabric move gently, then show one visible detail before returning to the full look. 2–7s Open on a close detail, pull back to reveal the complete garment, then hold a clean final view. 7–10s End on a stable, well-lit full view of the unchanged garment.
CAMERA: Use one smooth, controlled move; keep the garment recognisable and avoid revealing unseen sides. LIGHTING: Keep light and colour consistent, with realistic fabric texture and shadows.
AUDIO: Use restrained background music; keep it below any selected voice. Add SFX only when they match a visible action. No unrequested dialogue.
Finish with a sharp, stable product view. No morphing, duplicate garments, invented accessories, captions, watermarks or added logos.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Preserve the supplied garment's visible shape, colour, print, labels and construction; add no unverified features.
STYLE: Clean product-focused shot with thin white 2D doodles briefly tracing visible garment edges and details without covering them.
MODEL: Do not add an animal unless the supplied product is designed for animals; otherwise show the garment alone.
SCENE: a simple, tasteful fashion setting; keep the background simple and the garment clearly readable.
ACTION: 0–3s Reveal the garment from a three-quarter angle, make one slow lateral move, and finish with its shape and colour clearly visible. 3–15s Start with a full view, move closer to a visible seam or print, then return to the original framing. 15–20s End on a stable, well-lit full view of the unchanged garment.
CAMERA: Use one smooth, controlled move; keep the garment recognisable and avoid revealing unseen sides. LIGHTING: Keep light and colour consistent, with realistic fabric texture and shadows.
AUDIO: Use restrained background music; keep it below any selected voice. Add SFX only when they match a visible action. No unrequested dialogue.
Finish with a sharp, stable product view. No morphing, duplicate garments, invented accessories, captions, watermarks or added logos.
